test_title: PYST 199: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 25th Nov, 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the group of classes whose relationship is most appropriately represented by the following Venn diagram.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f919130ffe7b06443a4ac9d677d0518a31f3ae3982ba257fe5fb4fea0019cb31.png]
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given relation is as shown below :

 
• All Males are Humans.
 
• All Politicians are Humans.
 
• Some Males become Politicians.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fdc950496dd9c251fb2322452f533fdb012c17a355f7c1e5ecf5515eccdba4c6.png] 

Option 1) : India, Asia, Bangladesh

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08837a4f589b2b5588c5c6ef5907df390715f0e3ae5617f67b4bfff65d1704aa.png] 

Option 2) : Corn, Rice, Carrots

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87353a88e15ff55d7f2d8dd7747a11e5e65bad17f2d11211799b85d256ea4473.png] 

Option 3) : Natural Numbers, Integers, Rational Numbers

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20889f8ece317259594337afc186fd1dfb602e0e3a8679127864b6f1d93bbb87.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Human, Male, Politician".**
